limits: Each weight applies to the entire named table entry, including listed packaging, quantity, length or duration. No individual-unit division is made.
Waterskin weight is explicitly full; no empty weight or water density is inferred.
A source dash means no numeric weight supplied, not zero.
Vehicle row is a cross-reference, not a weightless tool; two non-SRD gaming sets are outside this table.
No carry capacity, encumbrance, current contents, or automatic state changes are inferred.
